tools.description: Find home-service and trade businesses enrolled in Book It that serve a US ZIP code for a trade, such as HVAC, plumbing, roofing or lawn care. tools.name: get_services
tools.description: Get one Book It business's services with any price range the business entered, its service-area ZIPs, its weekly hours for requests, its next open window, and the consent text a person agrees to before a booking request is sent.

tools.name: quote_range
tools.description: Return the price range a Book It business entered for one of its services, labelled as the business's own range and not a quote. When the business entered no range, says so. Book It never estimates, averages or invents a price.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: List the windows a Book It business accepts booking requests for, by date in the business's time zone, after its minimum notice and without its days off, for up to 14 days at a time. tools.name: request_booking
tools.description: Send a Book It business a booking request on a person's behalf. Collects only the person's name, phone, ZIP, what they need and a preferred time. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_booking · Public sink: request_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_booking · Public sink: request_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
